headline: 青春碎片今日爆火，蜘蛛侠领跑本周
headlineEn: Youth Fragments Surges Today; Spider-Man Leads the Week
summary: 今日仅1部新片上映，本周共5部新片开画。《青春碎片》空降热搜第一，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》领跑本周榜，《奥德赛》《鬼玩人：炼狱》《超级少女》持续霸榜。
summaryEn: Only one new film opened today, with five new releases this week. Youth Fragments topped trending, Spider-Man: Brand New Day led the weekly chart, while The Odyssey, Evil Dead: Purgatory, and Supergirl stayed hot.

industryHighlights.text: 今日仅1部新片上映，本周共5部新片开画。
industryHighlights.en: Only one new film hit theaters today; five new films opened this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《青春碎片》空降今日热搜榜首，成为最大黑马。
industryHighlights.en: Youth Fragments shot to No.1 on today's trending list as the biggest surprise.

industryHighlights.text: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》继续领跑本周热度榜。
industryHighlights.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day continues to lead the weekly trending chart.

industryHighlights.text: 《奥德赛》《超级少女》等多部大片保持高热讨论。
industryHighlights.en: The Odyssey and Supergirl remain highly discussed blockbusters.

industryHighlights.text: 《后室》《痴迷》等新片也进入本周热门榜单。
industryHighlights.en: Backrooms and Obsession also entered the week's top trends.
